passive.name: Night Hunter
passive.description: Vayne ruthlessly hunts evil-doers, gaining Move Speed when moving toward nearby enemy champions.

spells.name: Tumble
spells.description: Vayne rolls a short distance, and deals an additional physical damage on her next Attack. This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.
spells.coverageNote: A live-patch state module resolves every damage-relevant effect listed below.

effects.label: Empowered Next Attack
effects.description: For 3 seconds, the next basic attack adds physical damage and consumes the buff.

spells.name: Silver Bolts
spells.description: Passive: Every third consecutive Attack or Ability against an enemy deals an additional max Health true damage.
spells.coverageNote: A live-patch state module resolves every damage-relevant effect listed below.

effects.label: Silver Bolts Third Hit
effects.description: Basic attacks and Condemn add a 3.5 second stack. The third stack deals maximum-health true damage with a rank-based minimum.

spells.name: Condemn
spells.description: Vayne fires a bolt that Knocks Back and deals physical damage. If the target collides with terrain, they take bonus physical damage and become Stunned for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: A live-patch state module resolves every damage-relevant effect listed below.

effects.label: Condemn
effects.description: Deals physical damage and applies one Silver Bolts stack. Terrain collision adds a separate 150% bonus packet.
effects.formulaLabel: 50 / 85 / 120 / 155 / 190 + 50% bonus AD, multiplied by 2.5 on terrain collision

spells.name: Final Hour
spells.description: Vayne gains Attack Damage for seconds, extended by seconds whenever a champion damaged by Vayne dies within seconds. Additionally, during the duration:Night Hunter instead grants Move Speed.The Cooldown of Tumble is reduced by %, and grants Invisibility for second.
spells.coverageNote: A live-patch state module resolves every damage-relevant effect listed below.

effects.label: Final Hour
effects.description: Grants 35 / 50 / 65 bonus attack damage for 8 / 10 / 12 seconds.

effects.label: Tumble Cooldown
effects.description: Reduces Tumble cooldown by 30 / 40 / 50% while Final Hour is active.

effects.label: Movement And Invisibility
effects.description: Movement speed and invisibility do not change the supported damage result.
